protocol.fit_arithmetic: float64 centered SVD-backed affine least squares, ridge weights only
protocol.classes: source network greedy actions; final classes fixed for matched init and controls
protocol.head_blind: null space of two logit-difference weight rows; common logit shift retained; each encoder uses its own head
protocol.matched_init: complete final-policy observation/previous-action streams replayed from fresh zero carry at each episode; all 1024 steps including warmup; no carry reset at GRU 32-step training chunk boundaries; original final targets, classes and scored rows retained
protocol.controls: one fixed draw per fit/test split; shuffle complete token/previous-action pairs inside each episode except reset; random pair resampling from separate empirical reset/non-reset pools; targets and classes unchanged; label permutation on fit rows within class
protocol.uncertainty: 10000 paired whole-test-episode bootstrap draws; class means recomputed; probes held fixed; same resampled episodes for final and matched init; conditional on ONE training seed, fixed fit rows/probes; no between-training-seed inference
protocol.undefined: classes with fewer than two fit rows have excluded predictions; empty/constant class R2 is null; exclusions reported explicitly
protocol.archive_checks: four recorded discrepancies are annotations, not blockers; CPU within-run primary comparisons use verified checkpoint bytes
protocol.intermediate_selection: saved checkpoint closest to 2B steps; no matched-init comparison at intermediate; other ~200 saved stages not analyzed

archive_checks.tolerance_reason: Historical discrepancy threshold max(0.01, 5 * CPU episode-bootstrap SE), now annotations only by user authorization. No archived-parity hard stops. Primary matched comparisons use verified checkpoints and identical CPU histories.
